title: 宿舍-粉0305
description:
Ultra-high-definition product photography, 
﻿
a white ceramic face cream jar placed on the desk under the dormitory bed, showcasing 8K details.
﻿
Face cream should occupy at least one third of the picture.
﻿
The background blurred wall presents fine texture, and the bed pillars form a visual guideline on the right side. 
﻿
The left holds an adjustable silver table lamp, casting warm light on the left side of the face cream. 
﻿
On the right rear side of the desk, a light pink laptop forms a 30° angle with a rose gold pen. 
﻿
The front left glass succulent plant is 20cm away from the camera.
﻿
A white grid frame is hung on the wall, adorned with Polaroid photos and purple dried flowers. Below the grid frame, an acrylic storage box reveals colorful sticky notes. 
﻿
Behind the face cream, a makeup brush holder is closely attached to the wall, with three brushes arranged in a fan shape. 
﻿
On the right front side, a star and moon sticker surrounds an opened golden lipstick, with clear color label. Natural light reflects diffusely from the left outside the frame, casting fine grating shadows on the wall.
